description: Body reference metadata for canonical topology maps, per-body adapter transfer data, and physics configuration profiles.

physicsConfig.notes: This body has no physics bones. Physics-capable clothing physics will require converting to a physics body (e.g. 3BA/TBD/UUNP Special/UBE) or manually adding bone weights in Outfit Studio.

Supports CBPC and HDT-SMP. NPC LBreastRoot/NPC RBreastRoot are 3BA-specific root control bones above the standard breast chain — they must be preserved for CBPC/HDT-SMP to work correctly. NPC BellyRoot extends the belly chain for the softbody belly simulation. 3BA Softbody variant enables per-vertex HDT-SMP deformation via NiSkinData partitions. COCO uses the identical physics bone set as 3BA; COCO ↔ 3BA physics conversion is lossless.

Uses identical bone naming to 3BA: NPC L/R Breast01-03, NPC LBreastRoot/NPC RBreastRoot, NPC L/R Butt, NPC Belly, NPC BellyRoot. COCO ↔ 3BA conversion is near-lossless for physics configs. Standard CBBE-family CBPC configs with BreastRoot bones are directly compatible. COCOBody HDT-SMP XML (NickNak) required for softbody simulation.

HIMBO Physics Addon (separate HDT-SMP install) adds optional pectoral motion via NPC L/R Pectoral bones. Base HIMBO has no physics — the addon is a separate esp/esm. CBPC is not supported for pectoral physics. Use the same NPC L/R Pectoral mapping when converting HIMBO Physics content to BodyTalk Physics and vice versa.

BodyTalk Physics variant (separate HDT-SMP addon) adds pectoral motion via NPC L/R Pectoral bones — the identical bone naming used by the HIMBO Physics Addon. HIMBO ↔ BodyTalk physics conversion is lossless. CBPC not supported for pectoral physics. BT3 Muscle Solution is the most common physics-enabled variant.

Uses CBBE-standard NPC L/R Breast01-03, L/R Butt, NPC Belly bone names — no BreastRoot bones. CBPC configs are interchangeable with standard CBBE-family physics setups. TBD 3BBB adds HDT-SMP softbody support via NiSkinData partitions. When converting from 3BA or COCO, BreastRoot/BellyRoot bone weights must be collapsed to the standard chain.

SOS Regular uses HDT-SMP for genital physics via NPC GenitalsBase01-05 and NPC L/R GenitalsScrotum01 bones. SOS Light is the static no-physics variant. Always confirm the corresponding SMP XML config is present.
This body has no physics bones. Physics-capable clothing physics will require converting to a physics body (e.g. 3BA/TBD/UUNP Special/UBE) or manually adding bone weights in Outfit Studio.

BHUNP uses BHUNP-prefixed breast/butt bone names (BHUNP Breast L/R01-03, BHUNP Butt L/R) which differ from the NPC-prefixed names used by all other female bodies. NPC Belly is shared with CBBE-family. CBPC config must reference BHUNP bone names specifically. BHUNP has no BreastRoot bones (unlike 3BA/COCO). BHUNP Softbody enables per-vertex HDT-SMP deformation.

UUNP Special uses NPC L/R Breast01-03, L/R Butt, NPC Belly (same naming as CBBE-family). UBE (Unified Body Enhancer) is a UUNP alias. UUNP Special Softbody enables per-vertex HDT-SMP deformation using standard NPC bone names.
This body has no physics bones. Physics-capable clothing physics will require converting to a physics body (e.g. 3BA/TBD/UUNP Special/UBE) or manually adding bone weights in Outfit Studio.
This body has no physics bones. Physics-capable clothing physics will require converting to a physics body (e.g. 3BA/TBD/UUNP Special/UBE) or manually adding bone weights in Outfit Studio.

UBE uses the same NPC L/R Breast01-03, L/R Butt, NPC Belly bone names as UUNP Special. UBE physics configs are interchangeable with UUNP Special physics configs. UBE Softbody enables per-vertex HDT-SMP deformation via NiSkinData partitions.

Vanilla Skyrim body has no physics bones and uses the original Bethesda skeleton topology. Outfits targeting a physics body (3BA, TBD, UUNP Special, UBE, BHUNP) require a full re-weight pass in Outfit Studio against the target reference body before BodySlide sliders will output correctly.
